scripts.setup: cd client && pnpm install && cd ../server && pnpm install && pnpm exec prisma generate
scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c cyan,green "cd client && pnpm dev" "cd server && pnpm dev"
scripts.build: cd client && pnpm build && cd ../server && pnpm exec prisma generate && pnpm exec tsc
scripts.db:push: cd server && pnpm exec prisma db push
scripts.db:migrate: cd server && pnpm exec prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:studio: cd server && pnpm exec prisma studio
